description: X.509 certificate decoder — Decode a PEM certificate or chain offline (pem= URL-encoded, or url= of a .pem/.crt file): subject, issuer, serial, validity and days remaining, key type and size (RSA/EC curve/Ed25519), signature algorithm, SANs, CA flag, key usage, extended key usage, DV/OV/EV policy, OCSP/CA-issuer/CRL URLs, embedded SCT count, key IDs, SHA-256 and SHA-1 fingerprints, chain link check. Flags EXPIRED, NOT_YET_VALID, WEAK_RSA_KEY, WEAK_SIGNATURE_HASH, SELF_SIGNED, LEAF_VALIDITY_OVER_398_DAYS, WILDCARD, NO_EMBEDDED_SCTS; verdict OK/REVIEW/BAD. Refuses private keys. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cert_decode
